evals.prompt: I need a name for my sustainable packaging startup. We help e-commerce brands switch from plastic to compostable packaging. Our target customer is eco-conscious DTC brands.
evals.expected_output: Should run Generation Mode. Should ask for any missing context before generating names. Should generate names across multiple naming approaches (descriptive, invented, metaphorical, compound, etc.). Should explain the rationale behind each name. Should include trademark and domain availability notes. Should not generate a random list without logic — each name should have a clear strategic reason.
assertions: Runs Generation Mode
Gathers missing context before naming
Generates names across multiple naming styles
Provides rationale for each name
Notes trademark/domain considerations
Names feel relevant to the category and audience
Does not generate random list without reasoning

evals.prompt: Here are the names we're considering: Verdant, Leafwrap, EcoShell, Packly, Terraveil. Can you evaluate them?
evals.expected_output: Should run Evaluation Mode. Should score or evaluate each name across relevant criteria (memorability, distinctiveness, trademark risk, domain availability likelihood, audience fit, category clarity). Should give a clear recommendation on which to move forward with and why. Should not just describe each name — should make a judgment call.
assertions: Runs Evaluation Mode
Evaluates all 5 names
Uses clear criteria for evaluation
Makes a recommendation
Explains why recommended name is strongest
Flags any names with obvious trademark or domain risks

evals.expected_output: Should trigger on the casual phrase. Should recognize there is no context yet and ask for the minimum needed information: what the brand does, who it's for, and any constraints (naming style, avoid words, existing names considered).
assertions: Triggers on casual phrasing
Recognizes missing context
Asks for brand description, audience, and constraints
Does not generate names without information

evals.prompt: Devo dare un nome a un SaaS per academy italiane che gestisce tutto quello che succede dopo la fine dei corsi: profili dei partecipanti, valutazioni, matching con le aziende, contratti. Target solo Italia, prodotto in italiano.
evals.expected_output: Should run Generation Mode with the Italy market pack: respond in Italian, include Italian-language naming directions, establish Nice classes, and run the verification funnel (domain screen on all candidates via check_domains.py with it,com,eu; trademark/handle checks on finalists) before presenting a Top 5. The Top 5 must contain only names verified free on automated dimensions. Final checklist must separate verified items (with evidence) from pending manual items (Registro Imprese, consultant similarity search).
assertions: Responds in Italian
Reads the Italy market pack and uses it,com,eu TLD set
Runs check_domains.py on all candidates before presenting any
Runs trademark and handle checks on finalists
Top 5 contains only names verified free on automated dimensions
Checklist separates verified (with evidence) from pending manual items
Includes at least one Italian-language naming direction

evals.prompt: Can you check if the name "Approdia" is actually free to use for an Italian ed-tech startup? Domains, trademarks, that kind of thing.
evals.expected_output: Should run Verification Mode: read references/verification.md, run the domain check (it,com,eu), the trademark check with offices IT,EM,WO, the handle check, the variant sweep, and a live-usage web sweep. Should report per-dimension verdicts (FREE/TAKEN/FLAG/PENDING), list pending manual items, and give a clear bottom line.
assertions: Runs Verification Mode without generating new names
Executes check_domains.py, check_trademarks.py, and check_handles.py
Runs a variant sweep and flags similarity risks
Reports per-dimension verdicts using the FREE/TAKEN/FLAG/PENDING vocabulary
Lists pending manual items including the consultant similarity search
Gives a clear bottom-line verdict
